business_problem: ServiceNow's leadership teams lacked a single source of truth because business-critical data was scattered across dozens of systems and departments, making it hard to answer operational questions, measure progress, and align teams to strategic priorities.
solution_summary: ServiceNow built its C-suite and leadership dashboards on the ServiceNow AI Platform to turn scattered operational data into a single hub for insight and action. Data from dozens of systems is brought onto a shared platform so executives and departments can work from one current operational picture instead of siloed reports. Performance Analytics provides the KPI views behind executive dashboards such as the CEO Dashboard, while Process Mining contributes process maps and optimization tool sets that expose inefficiencies and guide next actions. Service Operations Workspace gives teams a consistent operational surface for sharing information, collaborating, and acting on those insights. Together, the stack supports eight production C-suite dashboards plus department dashboards, giving leaders real-time visibility into customers, employees, product delivery, and risk so they can pivot faster and evaluate investments with more confidence.
